messages:
Ali: Quick sync — we're aiming to align API/runtime/console/SDK version bumps for the 0.15 wave. Cutoff: Wed 2025-11-12 16:00 PT. Please confirm PRs, changelogs, and migration notes are ready. Ping me if you need more time. @Rajiv @Maria @Devon
Rajiv: Runtime should be fine; landing runtime PR (rt/0.15) this afternoon. Noted: need to update kernel selector doc. Will add changelog entry.
Maria: Console has one last UX fix (i18n); I can cut the console PR by EOD. Changelog draft at repo/console/CHANGELOG.md. Tagging @Devon for API compatibility check.
Devon: SDKs: I'm still waiting on the swagger bump from API. I can release patch SDKs after API tag — plan: branch sdk/0.15, run the test matrix on mac/linux. If API bump delayed, I can do staggered minor releases.
Ali: Thx. API owners — what's the ETA on the API spec bump + tag? Need it before 14:00 PT to allow SDKs + console to bake.
Sam (release-bot): Checklist update: 1) all PRs opened -> 4/4; 2) changelogs added -> 3/4; 3) migration notes -> 2/4; 4) canary window set -> pending. See /releases/0.15/runbook
Rajiv: FYI: runtime has a KV-cache schema change — migration note in PR. It won't be breaking for hosted but needs console to be aware for debugging flows.
Maria: Noted. Adding migration blurb and linking runtime PR. Also will add a UI feature flag for 2 weeks: `feature.version_0_15_ui`
Devon: I'll wait for the API tag. If we miss cutoff, recommend we do console + runtime in the wave and SDKs in a hotfix two days later.
Ali: Plan B sounds reasonable. Final ask: leave a short changelog summary in each PR body and ping me in the PR. I'll post a cutoff reminder at T-3h.
Tara (sre): Heads-up: canary infra reserved 18:00-20:00 PT. If anyone needs extra time, tell me now.
Ali: Great — will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
